title: 新中式饮品战争①：一家奶茶店，开了46479家 | China's Drink Wars P1 🧋
description:
你会为一杯奶茶排队吗？评论区告诉我。

【新中式饮品战争·第1集】一家奶茶店能开多大？截至 2024 年底，蜜雪冰城全球门店 46,479 家，门店数悄悄超过星巴克，成了全球现制饮品第一。秘诀简单到有点狠——一杯只要几块钱。新茶饮这几年卷成了海：一年上新上百款，联名、排队、拍照，便宜是最狠的武器。成都人喝到合口味，只说两个字：巴适。

How big can one tea brand get? By the end of 2024, Mixue had 46,479 shops worldwide — quietly passing Starbucks to become the planet's largest fresh-drink chain. The trick is almost brutal: a cup costs just a few yuan. China's new tea drinks have turned into an ocean — hundreds of new flavors a year, endless collabs, queues and photo walls, with cheap as the sharpest weapon.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Numbers checked this run; sources below. Neutral market observation, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
